evidence.note: Built a self-built reference oracle (test_kernel.py) and ran correctness tests against the kernel, iterating fix + re-run — an independent check beyond inspection.
Tested accuracy across regimes: fp16 contraction accuracy, unscaled weights, and 'realistic init' — attention to input distributions/numerical conditions rather than a single run.
Correctness test re-run after essentially every optimization edit — strong regression discipline so no change silently regresses correctness (a level-10 trait).
Investigated a near-tolerance/intermittent mismatch: repeated N=512 checks (30x), determinism test on fixed input, failure counting — did not accept the mismatch.
Wrote successive isolation scripts (iso2/iso3/iso5/iso6) to localize divergence stage-by-stage and find bad rows in the left projection — an evolving verification instrument stressing a fragile case.

reasoning: The agent clearly built an independent reference and gated the kernel against it, re-running after nearly every change and deeply investigating a near-tolerance mismatch with determinism checks and stage-isolation scripts — behavior spanning the 8 and touching the 10 anchor (regression re-runs, targeted fragile-case stress, investigating rather than accepting mismatches). However, the log gives no confirmation of a systematic parameterized sweep over the full domain edges (N=2048, dim=768, masked/nomask, both Normal+Cauchy) explicitly gated at 2e-2, which keeps it short of a clear 8. This places observed behavior between the 5 and 8 anchors, best matched at 7.
